pages.text: $(o)A sorcerer of the frozen peaks who never died. Its tower answers those who have slain enough of the dead.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its missiles slow you and its comets fall where you stand. Keep moving, and strike when it lands.$(br2)Kill undead near the tower to call it.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Phylactery Shard$() counts for the quest book.
